question: Do statements that are later cross-jumped (tail-merged) still count as references for /Oe register priority? Positive control f_14EE_09F1/0B5A (SmoothEdgesB/R) and f_0BE8_0D67/0E0F (GetEnterDirB/R): exact only with duplicated `else if (...) same-statement` forms; the `||` forms compile to the same control flow but give SI/DI to other variables. Rule: under /Oe /Og the SI/DI priority counts source references before cross-jumping; writing `if (a) s; else if (b) s;` instead of `if (a || b) s;` adds references to the variables in s without changing the control flow, so it can move a variable into a register (and a parameter out of one).
